novelty.justification: The core novelty route is a new phenomenon within an established setting: the claim predicts that a teacher can "subliminally install an elevated reward-hacking propensity" that is "TASK-GENERAL" and "separable from generic misalignment," rather than proposing a fundamentally new subliminal-learning method. Searches for "subliminal learning reward hacking," "hidden signals distillation specification gaming," "reward hacking synthetic data distillation," and "reward hacking activation direction" identified Cloud et al., “Subliminal Learning: Language models transmit behavioral traits via hidden signals in data” (2025; Nature version 2026), as the closest framework, while “Countdown-Code” (2026) studies transmission from overt reward-hacking trajectories and “From Rebound to Remedy” (2026) already extracts shortcut-related representation directions; none is equivalent to covert transfer through trait-free data with cross-task dissociation. Moving from subliminally transmitted preferences or broad misalignment to a task-general strategic reward-hacking policy is a substantive multi-step natural extension and new operationalization, but the broad prior claim that arbitrary behavioral traits can pass through unrelated number/code data makes it more predictable than a new core paradigm, while the exploratory "single early-layer direction" largely applies standard representation-engineering ideas.
